preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between 1 and the maximum possible number of unique roads between n cities inclusive.
The capital city s is a valid city number between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= ui <= n and vi != ui for vi, ui, _ in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two different cities, each with a valid city number between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= wi <= 1000 for _, _, wi in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road has a length wi between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The distance l from the capital to the missile silos is between 0 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for d in distances if d == l) + sum(1 for v, u, w in roads for d in [l - d1, w - (l - d1)] if 0 < d < w)
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of missile silos located exactly at distance l from the capital, including those on roads.
